database.executionMode: SET LOCAL ROLE foundation_gateway per query transaction

auth.customAuthentication: X-Shine-App-Token attestation followed by issuer-verified user JWT

requiredPreDeployment: Confirm the postgres platform connection can SET LOCAL ROLE foundation_gateway
Provision verified foundation.identity_bindings rows before user access
Provision app credential SHA-256 hashes in foundation.app_credentials before app access
Deploy Edge Function with verify_jwt=false because user JWTs may come from registered external Shine issuers and authentication is enforced in function code
